canonical_source.behavior: Reload retained site-operation history for the authenticated tenant from the authoritative source, expose loading/error/retry state truthfully, replace the rendered collection only from the authoritative read, and perform no mutation.

laravel_adaptation.loading: The Refresh control is disabled and aria-busy while the authoritative query is fetching, preventing duplicate ReloadAsync execution.
laravel_adaptation.success: Success is returned only after query.refetch resolves without an error and React Query supplies the authoritative payload.
laravel_adaptation.failure: A rejected or error-bearing refetch is classified as failed; the page's QueryError state exposes retry and does not render the collection as a successful reload.

security_boundary.tenant_context: tenant.context activates the authenticated membership before the route API adapter reads history
security_boundary.foreign_tenant: focused feature coverage proves a foreign tenant route is 404 and a reader without execution.view is 403
security_boundary.authoritative_scope: focused feature coverage proves only the active tenant operation history is returned
security_boundary.read_only: focused feature coverage snapshots total history row count and proves the reload GET performs no persistence mutation

acceptance_tests: variants/laravel-aiwmweb/backend/resources/js/__tests__/site-operations-reload-control.test.ts — proves duplicate reload suppression, success only after a clean authoritative refetch, and truthful error/rejection outcomes.

variants/laravel-aiwmweb/backend/tests/Feature/SiteOperationsReloadTerminalityTest.php — binds AIMW-BILL-B84663A4C0 to the real tenant-scoped route API read, proves authoritative tenant-only data, no mutation, auth/tenant middleware, permission denial, and foreign-tenant 404.

terminality.basis: The canonical ReloadAsync control is bound to a real tenant-scoped authoritative GET, blocks duplicate concurrent reloads, surfaces query failure through the existing retryable error state, and has focused tenant-isolation/read-only acceptance coverage.

scope_exclusions: No ExportCsvAsync, filters, details navigation, or adjacent Site Operations controls are claimed
